_note: THE CATCH-ALL (2026-10-21, branch intake-v4, fresh eyes after the pile; Jon: 'the view of the calendar isn't good enough to be relevant … I don't know why we need the phone to be on the right side as well … too many other notifications with extra words … tap what's yours is stupid and weird'): the Intake sheet's top object (src/components/IntakeCatchAll.astro). The LOCK SCREEN as it was, FIVE things he sent himself and nothing else (his notifications are off), each its own press; beside it INTAKE as itself, the web app, a panel, no phone; beneath both his CALENDAR, a real month, that pages to the day a landing takes. A press opens the thing so you see it, flies it into the Stream as its card, and the dated ones land on the month. The fifth is a memo from the wrist that plays, its words typed as spoken. An EXHIBIT, not a record: the save-the-date is capture 49 (the couple invented: Theo & June), the Marketplace line capture 53's, the Thundercat receipt a real one (✓ Idea · Oct 27), the memo capture 32 with the name swapped (Nico); 'boots lena' is invented. ⚠️ EVERY sentence here is a DRAFT in Jon's voice, his to rewrite; the lock screen's app names, the clock and the date are iOS's; Intake's chrome words, its empty line and its tiles are the app's own (intake_web.py). The timings live in IntakeCatchAll.astro's script.
